statement: ∀ (d c q : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < d → 0 < c → (N : ℝ) * d ≤ 2 → (N : ℝ≥0∞) * (ENNReal.ofReal (c*d)) ^ (q+1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2*c^(q+1)) * (ENNReal.ofReal d)^q
proof:
intro d c q N hd hc hN
rw [ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos (mul_pos hc hd), ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_pos hd]
rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg N),
  ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * c^(q+1))]
apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
rw [Real.mul_rpow hc.le hd.le, Real.rpow_add hd, Real.rpow_one]
calc
  (N : ℝ) * (c ^ (q+1) * (d^q*d)) = ((N : ℝ)*d) * (c^(q+1)*d^q) := by ring
  _ ≤ 2 * (c^(q+1)*d^q) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hN (by positivity)
  _ = _ := by ring

checked : ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Set (YuiEucl n)),
  (∀ (k : ℕ),
      (∀ (x : YuiEucl k) (t : ℝ), YuiHead (YuiSnoc x t) = x ∧ YuiLast (YuiSnoc x t) = t) ∧
        (∀ (z : YuiEucl (k + 1)), YuiSnoc (YuiHead z) (YuiLast z) = z) ∧
          (∀ (x y : YuiEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (YuiSnoc x t) (YuiSnoc y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
            LipschitzWith 1 YuiHead ∧ LipschitzWith 1 YuiLast) →
    (1 ≤ n →
        ∀ (q : ℝ),
          dimH E < ENNReal.ofReal q →
            ∀ (r ε : ℝ),
              0 < r →
                r ≤ 1 →
                  0 < ε →
                    ∃ T U,
                      E ⊆ ⋃ i, U i ∧
                        (∀ (i : ↑T), (U i).Nonempty ∧ 0 < Metric.ediam (U i) ∧ Metric.ediam (U i) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) ∧
                          YuiCost q U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) →
      ∀ (d c q : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
        0 < d →
          0 < c →
            ↑N * d ≤ 2 → ↑N * ENNReal.ofReal (c * d) ^ (q + 1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * c ^ (q + 1)) * ENNReal.ofReal d ^ q
